script_text: Leo, the cosmos is flipping your world upside down this week — and you won't see it coming. Early week, Mars squares your Sun in the 1st House, igniting tension and impulsive decisions through Wednesday. The Sun trines Jupiter in your 7th House midweek, pulling a powerful relationship or partnership into focus. By Thursday morning, Mercury enters your 10th House of career, aligning with Neptune to open a surprising professional opportunity. This coming weekend, Venus enters your 5th House of love, making Friday and Saturday your most magnetic days for romance and creative expression. Wednesday is your power day because Mars activates your 1st House confidence. Sunday is your worst day because the void-of-course Moon drains your energy after 2 PM. Leo, channel this fiery week into one bold career move — don't scatter your sacred fire across too many projects at once. Follow for daily updates.
